text:
Type: upholstered storage footstool
Use: resting feet, extra seating, storing blankets inside; living room, family room
Style: contemporary, classic
Materials: textured dark brown chenille-look woven fabric, piped edges, padded lid cushion, black plastic feet
Colors: deep chocolate brown
Shape: low rectangular box with a thick padded top and piped seams, short hidden feet, softly rounded corners, low and bulky
Feel: warm, cozy, rich, relaxed
